---
name: Report Fraudulent Transaction
description: File a fraud report for disputed charges on a card.
tool_constraints:
- file_fraud_report:
    requires: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_confirmed
---
File a fraud report for disputed charges.

Do not activate Card Replace or set replacement_reason during this skill; finish
the fraud report first.

:::ordered_block id=main
steps:
- id: ensure_card
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.card_disambiguation.selected_card_id
    then: route_load
  - else: call_card_disambiguation
- id: call_card_disambiguation
  call: card_disambiguation
  next: route_load
- id: route_load
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_filed
    then: filed
  - if: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.recent_transactions_card_id == session.card_disambiguation.selected_card_id and session.report_fraudulent_transaction.transaction_available
    then: mark_presented
  - else: load_transactions
- id: load_transactions
  execute_tool: fetch_recent_transactions
  next: route_after_fetch
- id: route_after_fetch
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: not session.report_fraudulent_transaction.transaction_available
    then: no_charges
  - else: show_charges
- id: show_charges
  action: utter_show_recent_charges
  next: mark_presented
- id: mark_presented
  execute_tool: mark_fraud_charges_presented
  next: select_charges
- id: no_charges
  action: utter_no_charges_to_report
  next: END
- id: select_charges
  instructions: |
    Identify which charges the customer disputes. Match what they said
    to the charge list already shown — record each disputed charge using the id from the
    matching row, not the merchant name. If they already named specific charges,
    record them without re-asking. Selection only — do not file yet.
    If the customer mentions card damage only as background (not their dispute), call
    note_replacement_hint and continue with fraud charge selection — do not start
    card replacement or set replacement_reason.
  complete_when: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.pending_fraud_transaction_ids
  next: collect_fraud_confirmed
- id: collect_fraud_confirmed
  collect: fraud_report_confirmed
  utterance: utter_confirm_fraud_report
  description: Whether the customer confirms filing the fraud report.
  next:
  - if: session.report_fraudulent_transaction.fraud_report_confirmed
    then: file_report
  - else: cancelled
- id: file_report
  execute_tool: file_fraud_report
  next: filed
- id: cancelled
  action: utter_fraud_report_cancelled
  next: END
- id: filed
  action: utter_fraud_report_filed
  next: END
- id: END
:::
